mode: Independent read-only review; no tests repeated
scope: Native consultation models() admission filter and its two new integration regressions

red.observation: Both fresh regressions observed catalogue HTTP 502 instead of 200 before filtering.

green.composition: 65 profile/composition cases and 29 existing host cases

checks.criterion: Off-policy and excessive capability entries remain rejected
checks.verification: Source inspection: normalizeModelCatalog and qualified.some(policy membership/maxOutputTokens) are unchanged and execute before the new filter. An incompatible ID cannot mask a failing policy check.
checks.test_limit: No new dedicated off-policy-loader regression executed; the preservation claim is by exact control-flow comparison.

checks.verification: The native regular expression is a strict subset of the execution-profile grammar. It matches HTTP/Edge and usage/SQL receipt identifier restrictions. Only incompatible identifiers are removed.
The bounded loader returns the filtered array before then() writes cache; downstream catalogue and consult consume that same array. No original unfiltered array is cached.

checks.criterion: No fallback or silent preference substitution
checks.verification: The exact selected main/reviewer model is resolved against the filtered catalogue; invalid resolution maps to IAO_INVALID. The new tests observe rejection and zero allocations/provider calls. The valid mixed-catalogue model executes only after an explicit valid selection.

Real internal HTTP plus production host/SDK/PGlite tests assert all-incompatible catalogue returns HTTP 200 with available=false/model_unavailable; mixed catalogue preserves the valid model and completes its explicitly selected request.
No policy, estimate, resolver, grant, single-flight, expiry, cancellation or begin logic changed. Existing 29 host tests and 65 matrix cases pass in the reviewed receipt.
Hash comparison against baseline confirms HTTP, Edge, usage, SQL migration, LM Studio transport and execution-profile resolver unchanged.

impact_context: models() HIGH was reported to the user by root before authorized edits; critical catalogue projection itself is unchanged. This review is not deployment approval.
limitations: This resolves false native capability admission by early exclusion, not by enabling @ models end-to-end.
The provider catalogue and completions in the integration tests are synthetic. Native account model availability, intelligence and billing remain separate qualifications.

The fix does not migrate or repair historical operations previously persisted via a direct host call with an incompatible model; existing resume-first behavior is unchanged and does not repeat inference.
Global LM Studio model grammar remains wider, as before; its independently qualified transport is not reconfigured by this native host filter.
